title: AI Taking Over Junior Dev Jobs?
full_monologue: **AI agents are replacing junior developers**. It's happening faster than you think. These AI tools can write clean code, debug issues, and even understand complex requirements — all in seconds. Companies are starting to see the cost savings and efficiency gains. But does that mean the end of entry-level coding jobs? Or could it be the beginning of a new era where humans focus on bigger problems? What do you think? Comment below.
